test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Change the following sentence from active to passive:

"The principal investigator might have been continuously analyzing the erratic fluctuations in the molecular structure caused by high- frequency radiation during the controlled simulations."

options.text: The fluctuations in molecular structure might have been continuously analyzed by the principal investigator during the simulations.
The erratic fluctuations caused by high-frequency radiation might have been continuously under analysis by the principal investigator during the controlled simulations.
During the controlled simulations, the erratic fluctuations in the molecular structure were continuously analyzed by the principal investigator.
Continuous analysis of the fluctuations in molecular structure by the principal investigator might have been performed during the controlled simulations.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The principal investigator might have been continuously analyzing the erratic fluctuations in the molecular structure caused by high-frequency radiation during the controlled simulations."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the erratic fluctuations in the molecular structure" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "might have been continuously analyzing" to "might have been continuously under analysis" (passive structure).
 
• Ensure clarity by retaining the phrase "caused by high-frequency radiation" and "during the controlled simulations" in their original context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"The erratic fluctuations caused by high-frequency radiation might have been continuously under analysis by the principal investigator during the controlled simulations."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The fluctuations in molecular structure might have been continuously analyzed by the principal investigator during the simulations." – Incorrect as it doesn’t include the phrase "caused by high-frequency radiation."
 
• **Option 3: **"During the controlled simulations, the erratic fluctuations in the molecular structure were continuously analyzed by the principal investigator." – Incorrect tense (simple past instead of "might have been continuously").
 
• **Option 4: **"Continuous analysis of the fluctuations in molecular structure by the principal investigator might have been performed during the controlled simulations." – Incorrect phrasing (awkward structure).
